The '''Karideph system''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] located within the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] where the [[Trition Trade Route]] met the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karideph]].
